reason: An app with my salon's own name and logo, WhatsApp bills and a prepaid wallet makes us look modern, and seeing cancelled bills, walk-outs and the drawer cash from my phone is worth far more than ₹500 a month. ₹10,000 with setup and training done at the salon is easy money for me to risk.
objection: The attendance check-in and the live view of who is in which chair can make my senior stylists feel I am watching them and don't trust them, and I can't afford good staff leaving or quietly not using it.
